description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for managing hooks in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting hooks, with annotations for Swagger documentation and JAX-RS RESTful services.

classes.name: HookApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing hooks, providing endpoints for CRUD operations and retrieving hook templates.

methods.name: retrieveHooks
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all hooks.

methods.name: retrieveHook
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific hook by ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a hook template for UI building.

methods.name: createHook
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new hook.

methods.name: updateHook
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing hook by ID.

methods.name: deleteHook
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a hook by ID.
